rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for entering a place without permission or welcome, often forcefully.

example.english: I saw a thief intrude into my home in the middle of the night.
example.jyutping: siu2 tau1 bun3 je6 cong2 jap6 ngo5 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this when someone turns up or comes over without being invited, especially in a social context.

example.english: They always intrude by showing up at my home at mealtime.
example.traditional: 佢成日唔請自來，食飯時間突然上我屋企。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 m4 ceng2 zi6 loi4 sik6 faan6 si4 gaan1 dat6 jin4 soeng5 ngo5 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this when stressing unauthorized entry or trespass, especially in complaints, warnings, or official contexts.

example.english: No one may intrude into this construction site without authorization.
example.traditional: 未經批准，任何人都唔可以擅自闖入呢個工地。
example.jyutping: mei6 ging1 pai1 zeon2 jam6 ho4 jan4 dou1 m4 ho2 ji5 sin6 zi6 cong2 jap6 ni1 go3 gung1 dei6
